name: FortiWeb — Web Attack Bypassed the WAF and Reached a Banking Application
description: Detects a real web application attack (SQL injection, XSS, known exploit, or malicious-IP request) that the FortiWeb WAF flagged but did NOT block (action = Alert, not Alert_Deny) against a public banking application (businessonline / mobile / loyalty / e-statement .nbi.iq). The WAF blocks the overwhelming majority of such attacks; an attack that passed through reached the application and is the highest-priority perimeter signal.
note:
## Investigation
1. `data.attack_type` is the attack class; `data.http_host`+`data.http_url` the exact target; `data.original_src`/`x_forwarded_for` the client; `data.msg` the signature detail.
2. Because it was not blocked, assume the request reached the app — check the application/DB logs (MS SQL / Oracle audit) for the same URL/time for signs of successful exploitation.
## Response
Block the source, confirm whether the request succeeded, and review the WAF policy for why this attack was not denied.
author: raadabujaish
query: tags:"Fortiweb" and data.type:"attack" and data.action:"Alert" and data.attack_type:("SQL Injection" or "SQL Injection (Extended)" or "Cross Site Scripting" or "Cross Site Scripting (Extended)" or "Known Exploits" or "SQL/XSS Syntax Based Detection" or "Generic Attacks" or "Generic Attacks(Extended)" or "Malicious IPs")
